title: Generation, expansion, and drug treatment of hematopoietic progenitor cells derived from human iPSCs
protocol: Seed 7 × 10^5 feeder-free iPSCs dissociated into single cell suspension from one well of a 6-well plate to a 3.5 cm² dish with SNL feeder cells in iPSC maintenance medium supplemented freshly with bFGF (30 ng/mL) and ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632 dihydrochloride) (10 nM).
Pre-cool centrifuge to 4°C on the day of EB formation.
Prepare APEL medium for EB formation, adding ROCK inhibitor (10 nM), bFGF (10 ng/mL), and BMP4 (40 ng/mL) to a volume suitable for forming up to 30 EBs.
Remove iPSC maintenance medium from iPSCs on the day of EB formation and wash once with warm PBS.
Gently detach SNL feeder cells by pipetting up and down several times during washing step.
Add 1 mL PBS/0.02% EDTA for 7 min to detach iPSCs in prepared APEL medium.
Remove PBS/EDTA solution and collect iPSCs in a Falcon tube.
Distribute 100 μl per well of iPSC suspension to a 96-well plate with conical bottom.
Centrifuge the plate at 435 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prepare Geltrex coated 6 well plates on day three.
Plate EBs on Geltrex coated wells (10 EBs/well) in 2 mL per well of APEL medium supplemented with VEGF, SCF, and IL-3.
Do not touch EBs for at least 24 hours.
On day eight, change the medium to 2 mL APEL supplemented with SCF (100 ng/mL), TPO (50 ng/mL), FLT3L (50 ng/mL), IL-3 (50 ng/mL), and IL-6 (20 ng/mL).
On day eleven, add 2 mL of APEL medium containing SCF (100 ng/mL), TPO (50 ng/mL), FLT3L (50 ng/mL), IL-3 (50 ng/mL), and IL-6 (20 ng/mL).
On day 14, harvest floating hematopoietic cells which are mainly CD34+CD45+ hematopoietic progenitor cells.
Confirm the presence of HPCs by flow cytometry analysis.
Conduct morphological evaluation using cytospin preparations.
Expand HPCs for at least 14 days on feeder cells or use them for drug treatment studies under feeder-free conditions.
Harvest 6 × 10^4 floating cells from EB-differentiation system at day 14.
Centrifuge the harvested cells for 5 min at 300 g.
Resuspend cells in 180 μL ice-cold FACS Buffer.
Add 90 μL of cell suspension into each FACS tube on ice.
Incubate the cell suspension with specific antibodies as described in the ‘List of antibodies for flow cytometry analysis of iPSC-derived HPCs’ for 20 min on ice and protected from light.
Wash stained cells by adding 1 mL ice-cold FACS Buffer.
Centrifuge the mixture for 5 min at 300 g, 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 150 μL ice-cold FACS Buffer.
Evaluate stained cells on BD FACS Canto II.
Analyze data with FlowJo software (BD Biosciences).
Critical: Keep antibodies protected from light to prevent degradation.
Harvest and spin down 20,000 cells/cytospin slide from EB-differentiation system at day 14.
Centrifuge samples at 300g for 5 min.
Prepare cytospin slides using Thermo Scientific Cytospin 4 Centrifuge at 250 rpm/10 g for 4 minutes.
Alternatively, add a drop of cell suspension to the slide and let it dry if cells may be damaged by centrifugation.
Stain cells in May-Grünwald-Solution for 5 min.
Rinse slides with dH2O after staining with May-Grünwald-Solution.
Stain cells in 1:20 diluted Giemsa-Solution for 20 min.
Rinse slides with dH2O after staining with Giemsa-Solution.
Let slides dry for at least 1 hour.
Take pictures of slides using a bright-field microscope with a 100× objective and oil immersion lens.
Add cells in IMDM and Anti-Anti to the MethoCult H4435 tube as described.
Vortex for 30 seconds.
Wait for 10 minutes until bubbles go up.
Seed 1.1 mL into each 3.5 cm dish.
Incubate at 37°C.
Count colonies after 14 days.
Prepare four 3.5cm dishes coated with collagen.
Thaw one vial containing 1.5 × 10^6 MMC treated cells in warm medium (DMEM + 15% FBS).
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 300 g.
Resuspend the cells in 4 × 2.5 mL HLTM medium with 10^-6 M Hydrocortisone and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.
Pipette 2.5 ml of cell suspension into each dish.
Leave for 24 hours in the incubator before seeding cells for expansion.
Thaw 1.5 × 10^6 Sl/Sl cells on the inner 8 wells of a 24-well plate.
Fill the outer wells with PBS.
Prepare HLTM medium supplemented with Hydrocortisone (10^-6 M) and cytokines freshly before adding cells for expansion.
Seed 1–2 × 10^5 iPSC-derived CD34+CD45+ cells/well of a 24-well plate with Sl/Sl feeder cells in 0.5 mL HLTM medium supplemented with cytokines.
Add 500 μL HLTM supplemented with Hydrocortisone (10^-6 M) and cytokines twice per week or change the medium completely.
Expand cells to a maximum density of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL, typically reached after 10–14 days.
Harvest CD34+ cells by gently pipetting up and down several times without detaching Sl/Sl feeder cells.
Analyze iPSC-derived CD34+CD45+ cells before expansion on Sl/Sl feeder by flow cytometry.
Perform flow cytometry analysis every 2–3 days to monitor proliferation experiment and quality of HPCs.
Count cell number every 3–4 days to monitor proliferation rate.
Test drug toxicity for Sl/Sl feeder (FLT3L) cells before applying any drug to the co-culture system.
Add the drug you want to test to the expansion medium.
Refresh half of the expansion medium with freshly added drugs every 3 days for most small molecules.
If cells expand slowly, change a half of the medium once a week.
Check viability of feeder cells regularly.
Pipette gently up and down culture medium to mix cells evenly without detaching feeder cells for counting.
Use a cell counting device of choice for counting.
Prepare serum-free CD34+ expansion medium freshly before adding iPSC-derived CD34+CD45+ cells.
Add drug in the required concentration to the expansion medium.
Seed 1–2 × 10^5 iPSC-derived CD34+CD45+ cells/well of a 24 well-plate in 1 mL CD34+ expansion medium.
Refresh half of the expansion medium with freshly added drugs every 3 days for most small molecules.
Change half of the medium once per week if cells expand slowly.
Pipette gently up and down cell suspension to mix cells evenly before counting.
Use a counting device of choice for counting.
